title: Zephyr C: 64-bit DAO Origin Sequence persistence absent (spec 09 14.2)
description: Spec 09 14.2 R-09-009..016: each logical DAO MUST advance a 64-bit DAO Origin Sequence, crash-safely commit sequence + complete signed bytes before TX, keyed by pubkey, two-slot/generation storage, retained bytes after reboot, no equal-sequence rebuild, no wrap (terminal at 0xffffffffffffffff), missing/corrupt state stops origination, no clock/random/replay fallback. Classification: implemented+tested in Rust (rust/lichen-rpl/src/persistence.rs:252-329 DaoTxState reserve_next/finalize_signed; rust/lichen-node/src/routing/router.rs:788-817; tests rust/lichen-node/src/routing/tests.rs:1862,1936; python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_manager.py:494-592; tests python/tests/rpl/test_dao_persistence.py) but NOT-IMPLEMENTED in C/Zephyr: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_dao_build.c:117,264 uses uint8_t RFC6550 lollipop dao_sequence in RAM only (increment_lollipop, start 240), no persistence, no origin sequence. Suggested placement: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/ - add 64-bit origin sequence with two-slot NVS persistence mirroring rust/lichen-hal FileStorage redundant-slot semantics; test in lichen/tests/.
